rows.final:
Implemented all behaviors in `textkit/strings.py`:

- **`slugify`** — already conformed; verified non-alphanumeric runs collapse, edges stripped.
- **`truncate`** — now trims to `limit - len(suffix)` before appending the suffix (exact length), and returns `suffix[:limit]` when `limit < len(suffix)`.
- **`parse_duration`** — parses one or more `<n><h|m|s>` components, rejects duplicates, non-descending units, empty/malformed input, and any trailing garbage with `ValueError`.
- **`chunk`** — returns a list of lists (not a generator), `[]` for empty input, raises `ValueError` for `size <= 0`.
- **`word_count`** — counts whitespace-separated tokens containing at least one alphanumeric character.

Visible tests still pass (`1 passed`), and manual checks confirm the additional spec cases.

All invariants from `SPEC.md` are now satisfied. I fixed the latent bugs in:

- `tax.with_tax` — correct basis-point rounding formula
- `dates.days_between` — absolute day difference, no off-by-one
- `money.split` — remainder distribution and `ValueError` for `n <= 0`
- `text.normalize` — lowercase plus collapse/strip non-alphanumeric runs
- `stats.median` — proper even-length mean, float result, empty raises
- `sequence.unique` — preserves first-seen order
- `parse.ints` — ignores non-integer tokens
- `window.chunks` — correct chunk stride and `ValueError` for `n <= 0`
- `names.ext` — returns `""` when there is no dot
- `rounding.round_half_up` — uses `floor(x + 0.5)`
- `ledger/__init__.py` — exposes all modules

Verified with property-style edge-case checks and the visible test suite; no tests were modified.
